scripts.db:bundle: sh -c '{ echo "-- Septer-M database setup: schema + security rules + order functions + starter catalogue."; echo "-- Paste this whole file into Supabase > SQL Editor and click Run. Run it once on an empty project."; echo "-- Generated from supabase/migrations/* and supabase/seed.sql (pnpm db:bundle). Do not edit by hand."; echo; for f in supabase/migrations/*.sql supabase/seed.sql; do echo "-- ===================== $(basename $f) ===================="; cat $f; echo; done; } > supabase/setup.sql'
